## Block `src-serve` — Live map server (interface)

Serves the live map on localhost: updates as the code changes, scopes of selected blocks, saving groups.

- Files: 1, under `src/serve`.
- Uses: Context (`src-context`: buildScopePack, resolveScope); Map (`src-map`: MapDraft, MapDraftSchema, addDoc, applyDraft, listMarkdownFiles, updateMap); Model (`src-model`: ArchModel, addBlock, addDependency, deleteGroup, docPathProblem, normalizeDocPath, removeBlock, removeDependency, saveGroup, saveModel, setLayers, unassignDoc, updateBlock); Outputs (`src-outputs`: buildViewData, refreshClaudeAgents, renderViewHtml); Run (`src-run`: ApprovalDecision, Runner, TaskManager, TaskSpec, builtInRunner, claudeCodeRunner, requestDraft); Project state (`src-state`: ProjectState, RequestScope, editAuthor, fileDiff, gitSignature, readChanges, readUsage, recordEdit, removeServeInfo, renderRequests, settleEdits, summarizeUsage, writeServeInfo).
- Used by: CLI (`cli`: MapServer, MapServerOptions, startMapServer).
- Most called from other blocks: `startMapServer` (2), `MapServer` (1). Check their callers before changing a signature.

With the Cantus MCP server: `block_context` (block `src-serve`) for this block's full briefing, `callers` before changing an export, `find_api` before writing a helper that may already exist elsewhere.
